about: Reserved ID registry for the station data set. Read SEED.md first. Everything listed here may be referenced by any worker. Pinned fields (composition, w, h, value, tier, depth, transmutes, tray, max_inputs, kind, phase) must be copied unchanged by the owner into its data file.

value_rule.applies_when: value_basis is 'craft' (the default); 'rarity' items skip it

decks.name: The Ring
decks.brief: Spun gravity, real light, real plants. Pays well, wants luxury, comfort, repairs, fast.

decks.name: Hub
decks.brief: Company offices and the clerks who run them. Licensed goods, paperwork, comfort.

decks.name: Core
decks.brief: Reactor and the engineers who live beside it. Cells, chips, parts, odd hours.

decks.name: Mid Decks
decks.brief: Technicians, orderlies, crew. Your stall is here. A bit of everything.

decks.name: The Dock
decks.brief: Haulers and crane crews. Ore and ice come in here; cells and parts go out.

decks.name: Works
decks.brief: Foundry and fab halls. Tools, filters, medicine for burns, cheap food.

decks.name: The Spine
decks.brief: Recycled air, bunks four high. Water, rations, filters, at thin margins.

residents.brief: Spine bunk tenant: water, rations, filters, on almost nothing.
Pulls salvage from the ducts: scrap, e-waste, now and then an heirloom.
Off the ore and ice runs: raw goods out, cells and parts in.
Foundry fitter: tools, spares, filters, burn salve.
Walks out with bars and slag; wants medicine and food.
Station tech: circuits, programs, parts, discs.
Clinic orderly buying stock: pills, bandages, antiseptic.
Reactor engineer: cells, chips, rumors about the power.
Company clerk: comfort, licensed software, paper.
Ring family: fresh food, wine, comfort, repairs.
Collects old things: books, lockets, fire, real anything.
Moves what should not move: fire, drugs, cracked software, stolen stock.

orgs.brief: The owner. Rent, tithe, memos, wage notices.
The spine clinic. Staple medical orders, thin pay, urgent.
Works union. Strike notices, bulk staples for the halls.
Ring residents' council. Festivals, luxury bulk orders, complaints.
The parcel carrier. Pickup notices, tier letters, delays.
No letterhead. Contraband orders, cracked attachments.

machines.name: Your hands
machines.brief: Not a thing. Cutting, stacking, filling, packing; always owned; instant, no cells, no energy.

machines.name: Workbench
machines.brief: Repair, refill, bundle, refurbish. ECONOMY.md's workbench.

machines.name: Smelter
machines.brief: The old furnace on cells: two ore into one bar, slag out.

machines.name: Recycler
machines.brief: Any item into its materials as unit items; 10% to sludge. Generic rule, no written recipes.

machines.name: Crusher
machines.brief: Breaks mixed scrap, e-waste and ice into sorted unit items, better than the recycler for raw lots.

machines.name: Purifier
machines.brief: Greywater or ice into clean water; a filter wears.

machines.name: Charger
machines.brief: Refills spent cells from station power; billed in credits at the power price.

machines.name: Hydro tray
machines.brief: Seed, water, nutrient and a lamp; grows over nights.

machines.name: Wired terminal
machines.brief: Runs programs from discs; mail, orders, remote for machines.

machines.name: Modem
machines.brief: Plugs into the terminal: mail, orders, boards. No modem, no mail.

machines.name: Slip printer
machines.brief: Small print surface: order slips, labels, receipts.

machines.name: Box sealer
machines.brief: Seals a packed box (mod_sealed). A sealed box opens only with a knife.

machines.name: Scanner
machines.brief: Reveals hidden modifiers (virus, counterfeit), composition and contraband flags.

machines.name: Radio
machines.brief: Engineers' chatter: rumors earlier and likelier right. Effects only.

machines.name: Digester
machines.brief: Sludge into biomass, salts, gas and water over nights.

machines.name: Vat
machines.brief: Biomass paste into rations, salami, cheese, bread. Recipe disc required.

machines.name: Fabricator
machines.brief: Bars and polymer into parts, tools, filters, housings. Blueprint disc required.

machines.name: Extruder
machines.brief: Polymer flake into sheet, tube and film.

machines.name: Kiln
machines.brief: Grit and slag into glass, vials, ceramics.

machines.name: Electrolyser
machines.brief: Water into oxygen and hydrogen. Drinks cells.

machines.name: Scrubber
machines.brief: Pulls carbon out of foul air; cartridges wear.

machines.name: Algae tank
machines.brief: Green water: biomass and oxygen from light, salts and gas.

machines.name: Still
machines.brief: Ferments and distils: ethanol, spirit, wine, distilled water.

machines.name: Chem bench
machines.brief: Reagents, antiseptic, coolant, lubricant, solvents.

machines.name: Pill press
machines.brief: Reagent and filler into pills and blisters.

machines.name: Loom
machines.brief: Fibre into cloth, gauze, garments.

machines.name: Pulper
machines.brief: Rags and lint into paper.

machines.name: Galley
machines.brief: Hot plate on cells, no flame: meals from vat food and crops.

machines.name: Document printer
machines.brief: Medium print surface: manuals, posters, books in sheets.

machines.name: Labeller
machines.brief: Puts a grade or licence label on goods (mod_label_*). Disc sets the label.

machines.name: Disc copier
machines.brief: A disc plus a blank of the same media into two. Generic rule; licensed discs refuse.

machines.name: Chiller
machines.brief: Pulls heat from a neighbour: clears Hot, slows overclock wear.

machines.name: Vent port
machines.brief: The outflow port: vents sludge and waste off station for a fee. Matter leaves the loop here.

machines.name: Hydro rack
machines.brief: Tall racks under lamps: fruit, herbs, fibre crops.

machines.name: Industrial vat
machines.brief: Big batches, gourmet discs, overnight runs.

machines.name: Precision fabricator
machines.brief: Tight tolerances: bearings, valves, machine parts, phase 3 machines.

machines.name: 3D printer
machines.brief: Reads models from a memory card; prints polymer and light metal.

machines.name: Assembler
machines.brief: Boards, chips and housings into devices and computers.

machines.name: Cell press
machines.brief: Makes power cells from lithium, metal and reagent.

machines.name: Synthesiser
machines.brief: Builds molecules: drugs, new polymer from carbon and gas.

machines.name: Cellar
machines.brief: Cold, dark, patient: ages cheese and wine over nights (mod_aged).

machines.name: Jeweller's bench
machines.brief: Noble metal and stones into rings, lockets, engraving.

machines.name: Annealer
machines.brief: Tempers tools and parts (mod_tempered): more uses, more worth.

machines.name: Banner printer
machines.brief: Large print surface: banners, art prints, ad sheets.

machines.name: Broadcaster
machines.brief: Ads on the deck feeds: more buyers of one need for a while.

machines.name: Workstation
machines.brief: Faster, bigger computer: more memory, more ports, runs automation.

machines.name: Autofab
machines.brief: Industrial fabricator: any blueprint, batches overnight.

machines.name: Bioreactor
machines.brief: Digester and vat in one tank: sludge in, culture food out.

machines.name: Mainframe
machines.brief: Runs automation for every machine at once; hosts the black-market client at scale.

machines.name: Refinery
machines.brief: Recovers rare earths and noble metal from e-waste and slag.

items.name: Biomass paste
items.brief: Unit item of mat_biomass. Grey brick; the vat's feedstock.

items.name: Greywater
items.brief: Unit item of mat_water. Not for drinking until purified.

items.name: Reagent dregs
items.brief: Unit item of mat_reagent. Crude, mixed, useful.

items.name: Sludge
items.brief: Unit item of mat_sludge. Digest it or vent it.

items.name: Iron ore
items.brief: Hauled in at the dock. Two lumps make a bar.

items.name: Ice block
items.brief: Comet ice, dirty, hauled in. Water and gas when melted.

items.name: Mixed scrap
items.brief: A lot of junk: crush or recycle it.

items.name: E-waste
items.brief: Dead boards and screens. Worth more crushed than whole.

items.name: Noble bar
items.brief: A small heavy bar. Jeweller's stock.

items.name: Steel sheet
items.brief: Rolled from a bar, two to a bar.

items.name: Copper wire
items.brief: A coil; four to a copper bar.

items.name: Fasteners
items.brief: A tin of bolts and rivets.

items.name: Pipe
items.brief: A length of steel pipe, threaded.

items.name: Valve
items.brief: A brass-seated valve for water and gas lines.

items.name: Spare part
items.brief: The generic machine part the station runs on (need_parts).

items.name: Glass vial
items.brief: Empty, stoppered. Med and lux fill these.

items.name: Bottle
items.brief: Clear glass and a cork. Empty.

items.name: Tin can
items.brief: Empty can and lid, for food.

items.name: Kitchen knife
items.brief: Cuts cheese, salami, bread, sealed boxes. A tool, wears.

items.name: Wrench
items.brief: Clears jams, fits parts. A tool, wears.

items.name: Device housing
items.brief: A shell with screw posts, for tech.

items.name: Small cell
items.brief: Machine fuel, replaces coal. Drains, recharges.

items.name: Chip
items.brief: A processor in a black package.

items.name: Grow lamp
items.brief: Hydro light. A tool: wears per night.

items.name: Order slip
items.brief: Printed by the slip printer; a box ships only with one.

items.name: Water jug
items.brief: Four litres in a sealed jug.

items.name: Oxygen canister
items.brief: A full canister of breathing gas.

items.name: Algae mat
items.brief: Wet green mat from the tank; vat feedstock.

items.name: Ration bar
items.brief: The staple. Eat one for energy.

items.name: Sugar
items.brief: Refined sugar packet: still and kitchen feed.

items.name: Plant oil
items.brief: Pressed oil in a plastic flask: food, salve base, lamp oil.

items.name: Apple
items.brief: Ring fruit. Real ones are rare; synthetic is a modifier.

items.name: Sandwich
items.brief: Two slices and a filling slice; worth more than its makings.

items.name: Cheese wedge
items.brief: An eighth of a wheel, six slices.

items.name: Ethanol
items.brief: Lab spirit in a vial: antiseptic base, lighter fuel, drink if desperate.

items.name: Blister card
items.brief: Empty foil card for six pills; filled ones list fill.

items.name: Stim
items.brief: Use: +1 energy now, stat_wired, crash tomorrow.

items.name: Paper
items.brief: A short stack of pulped sheets.

items.name: Cloth
items.brief: A folded length of woven cloth.

items.name: Wine
items.brief: A distillate in a green bottle. Ring luxury.

items.name: Candle
items.brief: Open flame on a station: contraband (fire).

items.name: Matchbox
items.brief: Empty box; fill is ten matches. Contraband (fire).

items.name: Book
items.brief: Paper, so an heirloom. value_basis rarity.

items.name: Coolant
items.brief: Use on a machine: clears stat_hot.

items.name: Lubricant
items.brief: Use on a machine: lowers jam chance for a while.

items.name: Water filter
items.brief: Purifier tool; wears. Spine bunks buy them too.

items.name: Air cartridge
items.brief: Scrubber tool; wears. Serves need_air in bunks.

items.name: Steel cabinet
items.brief: Container, holds more than it looks.

discs.brief: Carbon capture and gas sorting profiles.
New polymer from carbon and gas.
Blank memory card. Copy target, model storage.
Unlabelled discs found in salvage: diaries, logs, schedules. Sellable information.
Day summary by need and event.
Live need prices and trend arrows.
Modifier: machine jobs cheaper, jam risk up.
Wholesale account client: crates at market price.
Rumors earlier and more often right.
Scripts load and start machine jobs.
Strips licence checks. Contraband (software), may carry a virus.
Encrypted client for black-market orders. Contraband (software).
Ring medicine: regrowth gels, gene patches.

programs.brief: Prints slips and labels on mach_printer_s.
Day summary by need and event.
Scripts start machine jobs: saves energy.
Dock manifest: what ships, what each box pays.

statuses.brief: Stops jobs. Clearing costs energy (and a wrench).
Jobs cost less energy; jam chance up.
Yield down, jam chance up. Coolant or chiller clears.
No charged cell in the slot.
Needs a spare part; yield down.
A virus rode in on a disc: random jams, slower jobs.
Ate a proper meal: +1 energy cap today.
Security has noticed you: inspection chance up.
Power gauge low: cells dearer, charger slow.

modifiers.brief: Grown or made the old way. Ring pays more.
A sealed box. Ships. Opens only with a knife.
Software paired to a machine or key.
Licence removed. Spine buys it cheap; may hide mod_infected.
Hidden until scanned. Spreads on copy; symptoms on machines.
Copy of a copy: chance a job or program fails.
Annealed: more wear uses, more worth.
Ring-grade label: ring buyers pay more.
Company licence label: legal in the hub, sells to orders asking for it.
Cellared: cheese and wine worth more.
Personalised: heirloom value up, sells to one buyer type.
Repaired on the bench: worth less than new, more than broken.
A fake label or licence. Hidden until scanned. Contraband (stolen).
Broken or dented: worth half, repair on the bench.

inflow_channels.haul: Ore and ice hauled in at the dock (sys_ore_haul, sys_ice_haul); bought at the dock counter at night (outside.json).
inflow_channels.crate: Ordered on the terminal (the Company Store, wholesale, upgrades); arrives through the dock or the outside counter.
inflow_channels.seller: Walk-in sellers and traders bring it (residents.json sells must list it).
inflow_channels.salvage: Scavenge sites at night (outside.json), and spine scavengers in the line; cheap, random lots.
inflow_channels.mail: Arrives as a mail attachment (orders.json attachments must list it).
inflow_channels.company: Issued by the company (memos, starter kit, tithe returns).

Multiplier on the energy a job costs.
How many machines may run overnight (start: all placed).
Multiplier on cell charge a job drains.
Multiplier on the charger's credit cost.
Multiplier on output quantity (rounded per job).
Days of warning before an event.
Arrival weight for an advertised need.
Carrier pickups per day (0.5 = every two days).
Multiplier on the tithe order's size.
Devices that can be plugged into the computer.
0 none, 1 arrows, 2 live numbers on need chips.
0/1: can order crates at market price.
Station supply of a need (scope a need).
Station demand for a need (scope a need).
Daily chance of a security inspection.
Multiplier on a tool's wear uses (modifiers).

Chance an infection spreads on copy or load.
